warnings: FACTORIAL DESIGN: 2x2 factorial with CO2 (ambient vs elevated) and Temperature (ambient vs elevated) - must extract CO2 effect separately at both temperature levels
THREE COHORTS: Data presented for 1997, 1998, and 1999 needle cohorts separately - each cohort measured at two ages (current-year and 1-year-old), creating multiple time points per cohort
ONLY 4 TREES PER TREATMENT: Very small n (2-4 replicates per treatment), reducing statistical power

INTERACTION EFFECTS: The paper reports CO2 x Temperature interactions; the combined treatment (+CO2+T) may not show the same direction of effect as +CO2 alone - extract +CO2 vs AmbC separately, not +CO2+T vs +T
CONTROL IS 'AmbC' (ambient control chamber): AmbC is the appropriate control for CO2 effects, not outside ambient air
TABLE FORMATTING ISSUES: Tables appear to have OCR/extraction artifacts with some values misaligned or merged - verify each value carefully
NUTRIENT TABLE SPLIT: Table 5 spans multiple pages (Table 5 and 'Table 5 Continued') with different elements - ensure all elements are captured
SOME NUTRIENTS LACK OPTIMAL RANGE: Table 5 header shows optimal range only for some elements; not all elements have defined optimal ranges
SIGNIFICANCE NOTATION: Increases shown as arrows up (↑), decreases as arrows down (↓); interaction effects shown as +/- signs - these are different from treatment effects
TRANSIENT EFFECTS: Authors note effects are most pronounced in 1997 cohort (first treatment year) and diminish in later cohorts - this temporal pattern is important for interpretation
TEMPERATURE EFFECT ON NUTRIENTS: Elevated temperature also decreased many nutrient concentrations, similar to CO2 effect - do not confuse temperature-mediated changes with CO2-mediated changes
VPD DIFFERENCE: VPD was slightly higher inside elevated temperature chambers, which could confound transpiration-related nutrient effects
MISSING DATA: Some cells in tables appear empty (especially 1999 cohort data), as only current-year needles were studied in 1999
WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
